params.name: page
params.description: Results are paginated. Specify current page.

params.name: records_per_page
params.description: This specifies the number of records to be returned on each page. Defaults to `25`. The valid range is from `10` to `1000`. If the value exceeds `1000`, the default value of `25` will be used instead.

params.name: is_disabled
params.description: Search for users that are diabled.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to list every user you've created in the MX Platform API.

Use this endpoint to create a new user. The API will respond with the newly-created user object if successful, containing a `guid` that you'll set as the `user_guid` in other requests when required. Disabling a user means that accounts and transactions associated with it will not be updated in the background by MX. It will also restrict access to that user’s data until they are no longer disabled.

params.name: user_guid
params.description: The unique identifier for a `user`, beginning with the prefix `USR-`.

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to delete the specified `user`. The response will have a status of `204 No Content` without an object.

:::warning
Deleting a user is permanent. Deleted users can never be restored. For more info, see [Deleting Objects](/api-reference/platform-api/overview/deleting-objects).
:::
